tools.name: list_tarot_cards
tools.title: List tarot cards
tools.description: List the tarot deck used by this app (78 cards). Optionally filter to major or minor arcana. Returns names and short upright/reversed keywords.

arcana.description: Which arcana to list. Defaults to all.

tools.name: get_tarot_card
tools.title: Get tarot card meaning
tools.description: Look up one tarot card by Chinese or English name (or partial name) and return its full meaning: imagery, upright and reversed interpretations, and background.

name.description: Card name in Chinese or English, e.g. 愚者 or The Fool.

tools.name: draw_tarot_spread
tools.title: Draw a tarot spread
tools.description: Shuffle this app's tarot deck and draw a spread (timeline, choice, or single card) with random upright/reversed orientation. Returns each drawn card with its position and meanings so the caller can interpret the reading.

question.description: The querent's question, echoed back in the result.

spread.description: Spread type. Defaults to timeline (past / present / future).
